en: Conditioned by a state that does not lead to accumulation and is not wholesome, a state that leads to accumulation and is wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root; ... [and so on] ... six under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that does not lead to accumulation and is not unwholesome, a state that leads to accumulation and is unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... [and so on] ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that neither leads to accumulation nor is indeterminate, there arises a state that neither leads to accumulation nor leads to diminution and is indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are five under root; five under predominance … pe … five under non-disappearance.
